meta.name: Love Script
meta.description:
Wealthy and brilliant Zhu Xuanwen lives in his own world, convinced he’s Emperor Jianwen of the Ming Dynasty. When mental health professional Luo Kaihuai takes on his unusual case, she must navigate his eccentric “imperial court” and stubborn delusions to reach the man behind the emperor.

Complete series. On your server: S1 24/24

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Xuanwen is on the way to a jewelry event. His car suddenly loses control and gets into a severe car accident. After he wakes up in the hospital, he doesn't remember anything.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Xuanwen believes he is an Emperor Jianwen of the Ming Dynasty. His family hires Luo Kaihuai to treat his mental illness.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Kaihuai tries to understand Xuanwen's delusion so that she can enter his world and treat his illness efficiently and effectively.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Dai Fu realizes that Xuanwen is into Kaihuai. He asks Kaihuai to take care of Xuanwen's illness without any intention and stay away from Xuanwen.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dai Fu threatens Kaihuai with scissors and asks her to stay away from Xuanwen. Kaihuai feels confused because she just wants to work hard and get her money every month.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Xuanwen, Kaihuai, and Dai Fu go shopping together, but Paparazzi shows up. During the argument, Xuanwen punches Paparazzi, and the video is all over the internet.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: To find evidence and prove Xuanwen's innocence, Kaihuai and Dai Fu work together to see all of the surveillance footage in the mall.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Kaihuai packs up her luggage and leaves the palace. She sits on the roadside, and Zhu Li runs into her. Zhu Li decides to take her to the mall to clean up herself.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Xuanwen is unhappy after Kaihuai leaves his palace. He stops eating and drinks until Kaihuai returns to take care of him.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Xuanwen is recovered from his mental illness. However, he decides to hide this truth to monitor his enemy, who tries to hurt him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Kaihuai feels suspicious about Xuanwen's mental illness. She has been monitoring Xuanwen and see if he is recovered. However, Dai Fu helps Xuanwen with hiding the truth.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Someone poisons the chicken soup, and Linda is in a coma after drinking it. Xuanwen asks Kaihuai to investigate and find out who does it.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Kaihuai is visiting the design department. After she views a brooch, she feels dizzy and passes out. Xuanwen covers Kaihuai with his coat and carries her away.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Kaixiao finds a guy called Li Lin who is interested in cars. Also, he has very in-depth research on luxury cars' central control system. Kaixiao wonders if Li Lin modifies Zhu Xuanwen's car.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Father Luo mentions Zhu Li and Zhu Xuanwen to Luo Kaihuai. He thinks Kaihuai can get to know Zhu Li. However, Luo Kaihuai already falls in love with Zhu Xuanwen.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Zhu Xuanwen reveals his recovery to the board of directors. He also tells the facts that he pretends to be sick and asks why Mei Changting damages his car.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: It turns out that Kaihuai has a mental illness. Kaihuai leaves Xuanwen and decides not to see him again. Xuanwen has been looking for Kaihuai.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Kaihuai is mad at herself and Xuanwen. She is not happy about Xuanwen lying to her about his recovery. She also disappoints herself because she, as a psychologist, falls to know her patient's condition.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Kaihuai thinks she is over Xuanwen, but it turns out that she is still in love with Xuanwen.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Xuanwen tells Kaihuai that he has learned a lot since he met her. Because of her, he begins to accept the world and listen to others' voices.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Xuanwen asks Kaihuai's father about her mental illness. When Kaihuai is a kid, she loses in the woods and has a high fever for several days. After she gets better, she can't remember anything.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: It turns out that Xuanwen is the little boy who goes into the mountains with Kaihuai back then. Zhu Xuanwen's leg is also injured at that time.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Kaihuai wants to study abroad, and Zhu Xuanwen agrees with her request. Xuanwen wants her to their wedding pictures first before she leaves.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Xuanwen proposes to Kaihuai in front of people. When he is sick, he needs her because she is a psychologist. Now, He needs her because he loves her and can't live without her.
